fields.name: name
fields.description: The descriptive label for this node.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Reference to the parent node in the hierarchy; empty marks a root.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Icon name shown beside the node.

events.name: OPEN_NODE
events.description: Signals a tree node has been selected for external handoff.

events.name: CHILD_REQUESTED
events.description: Create a new record under this node — the host routes it into its create-draft writer with parentId stamped.
events.synonyms: new subpage, add child page, create under

events.name: TreeNodeLoaded
events.description: Indicates the tree node collection has been successfully retrieved.

events.name: TreeNodeLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load the tree node collection.

events.name: SET_CURRENT
events.description: Mark this record as the open one (routed from the host document's load events); its row highlights and its ancestors auto-expand.
events.synonyms: highlight current, select node, you are here

events.name: REFETCH_QUERY
events.description: Triggers a tree refresh based on the current search query.

events.name: REFETCH_FILTER
events.description: Triggers a tree refresh based on current filter criteria.

events.name: ADD_CHILD
events.description: The row's hover + affordance was clicked.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the tree's own search box?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Embeds a search box above the tree that re-fetches the flat node set server-side. Set false (the default) when the page already provides a search affordance (a toolbar Search molecule), so the surface shows one search box instead of two.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: inline search, list search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

overridableConfigKeys.label: Row + affordance?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render a hover + on every row that emits CHILD_REQUESTED { parentId } — wire it to the host's create-draft writer so new records are born inside the node.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: add inside, new subpage button, plus on rows

overridableConfigKeys.label: Row + tooltip
overridableConfigKeys.description: Accessible label on the row's + affordance (e.g. New subpage).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Filter bar look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which filters should appear above the tree?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the tree; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait, re-fetching the flat node set. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this tree and routes `XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER` — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

overridableConfigKeys.label: Icon column
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field holding each node's icon name; point it at a nonexistent field (or empty) to suppress per-node icons.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Label column
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field rendered as each node's label. Config-driven on purpose: the trait-level `fields {}` remap is compiled-path-only (the JS runtime never applies it), so a rebind names its columns here and both execution paths agree.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: title field, name column, display field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tree look
overridableConfigKeys.description: full = standalone section (heading, count, divider); rail = compact sidebar navigation (slim caption, nav-styled rows) for an app layout's sidebarTrait slot.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: sidebar tree, rail look, nav tree, compact

overridableConfigKeys.label: Parent column
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field holding the parent reference the hierarchy nests by.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Search box placeholder text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hint text inside the tree search box (e.g. 'Search nodes…').
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label
